measurement: Traction force, force response, standardized collagen-gel contraction, or predefined morphology index
minimum_replication: >=3 independent donors; >=3 technical wells per condition
success_rule: Challenge-versus-relaxed response is directionally concordant across donors
failure_or_boundary: Null or donor-discordant response retains CAUTION

measurement: ITGB1/ITGAV or focal-adhesion perturbation with matched vehicle/non-targeting control
minimum_replication: Same donors and conditions as E01
success_rule: Perturbation attenuates the mechanical response without unacceptable toxicity
failure_or_boundary: No attenuation means no pathway-dependence claim

measurement: Rho/ROCK or actomyosin perturbation with matched control
minimum_replication: Same donors and conditions as E01
success_rule: Perturbation attenuates contractility or the primary response without unacceptable toxicity
failure_or_boundary: Toxicity or absent target engagement is uninterpretable

measurement: Nuclear-to-cytoplasmic localization or predefined equivalent readout
F-actin stress fibres, vinculin/paxillin features, or equivalent imaging score
success_rule: Mechanical response is accompanied by prespecified structural change
failure_or_boundary: Cannot replace E01 as primary endpoint

measurement: Live/dead, ATP, cell count or attachment QC
success_rule: No material condition-specific loss that explains E01
failure_or_boundary: Predefined failed wells excluded and reported

success_rule: E01 persists after proliferation sensitivity analysis
failure_or_boundary: Coupled proliferation remains a competing explanation

measurement: Predefined protein or transcript marker panel
success_rule: E01 is not adequately explained by generic state shift

measurement: Expression, protein or functional calcium response
success_rule: Positive or null result reported without changing E01 decision

measurement: Effect size, 95% CI, donor-wise direction, technical variation and missingness
success_rule: All primary and mechanistic claims trace to donor-level outputs
